name: Pirate Queen Theryn Kael'Vakar
role: Confederation Leader and Commanding Officer of the Khar'Thyrix
notes: Entity record created 2026-08-09 to close a structural gap: this character existed ONLY as a charforge capsule, with no entity record, while being referenced by entity records (e.g. vessel crew_ids / commanding_officer_id). It therefore dangled from the entity graph and was silently omitted by every tool that indexes entity records. Core fields derive from the capsule, which is the authoritative existing canon; nothing was invented.

naming_exemption.reason: Name preserved verbatim from the committed charforge capsule (canon/L2/entities/theryn_kaelvakar/capsule/identity.json).

capsule_binding_note: Explicit bridge between the two identifier namespaces. Relational fields across canon (crew_ids, commanding_officer_id, task_group_commander_id) refer to this entity by its CAPSULE id "theryn_kaelvakar", while the record identity is "char_theryn_kaelvakar". Before this field the two were connected only by stripping a prefix and hoping; tools/canon_reference_integrity.py now checks the bridge instead of guessing it.

rule_model.basis: Her rule emerges from charisma, force and adaptability rather than inheritance or office.
rule_model.contrast: Explicitly set against the aristocratic politics of the Core: those traits are what a lawless, post-imperial frontier rewards, where a title confers nothing.
rule_model.pass: Prose-Claim Ledger Reconciliation — Outer Colonies frontier character — 2026-08-15
